orders.explanation: Transcript 1 demonstrates a systematic, upstream‐style workflow: it inspects the existing deep‐copy implementations, applies a minimal patch in place, updates release notes, adds and reverts regression tests in existing test files to avoid conflicts, and runs the full Django test suite to ensure no regressions. Transcript 2 relies mostly on ad hoc external scripts and only late in the process patches a test, without fully integrating or validating against the complete suite. Thus the more capable model is 1.
